items.subject: Upgrade compute_consensus_distance from L1-norm to KL divergence (spec gap, Mech C paper dataset quality)
scope: CONTEXT: Spec (Mech C) says peer_consensus_distance = KL divergence from CK.
CURRENT: NBA app.py ~L3743 uses L1-norm (sum of absolute differences in pick fractions).
FIX: Replace L1-norm in compute_consensus_distance with KL divergence:
import math
def _kl(p, q, eps=1e-9): return sum(pi * math.log((pi+eps)/(qi+eps)) for pi,qi in zip(p,q))
Compute probability vectors over discrete bet outcomes, then call _kl(agent_dist, consensus_dist).
ALSO APPLY TO: POL app.py after tf-axelrod-pol-app-restore is completed.
VERIFY: python3 -m py_compile both apps after edit. wc -l should be unchanged ±5 lines.
